reason: Every ambient packaged green chutney in India uses heavy doses of vinegar and citric acid to prevent spoilage, leaving a sour chemical taste that ruins parathas. Unless it tastes exactly like freshly crushed mint and coriander without preservatives, I'd rather deal with dabba leaks than eat sour synthetic paste.
objection: Artificial chemical preservatives and overpowering vinegar acidity that destroy authentic fresh chutney taste.
would_change_my_mind: A cold-chain, preservative-free version with verified fresh taste that doesn't rely on vinegar for shelf life.
